admission.justification: A stop by an install called from inside the host closes its own session halfway; test_paseo_install_no_stop exercises the admission, the irreversible sites, the late restart and the non-answering supervisor.

applicability: An install (runtime_install's host step) whose home holds a live supervisor.
conditions: The step reads whether a stop would be needed: installed version, running version, listen address, start-only settings, lock and Node executable.
When a stop is needed the host part says restartRequired with the reasons and the terminal remedy; ok stays true and nothing of the host changes.
exclusions: Explicit `agents-remember paseo provision` keeps stopping and starting when that is needed.
A live host observed after admission is still protected at the irreversible sites; the install refuses rather than replacing it.
